# Odovey Consulting

> Harness engineering consultancy for agentic AI. Every AI agent is a model inside a harness: the model is the mind, the harness is the body. We build harnesses, from purpose-built agents to agent platforms, enable engineering teams through co-build and advisory, and train teams in harness engineering.

## About

Odovey Consulting focuses on harness engineering: designing, building, evaluating, and hardening the harness around a model. A harness reduces to five primitives: Input (captures what comes in), Context (assembles what the model is shown), Model interface (requests a response from the model), Output (handles the model's outputs), and Control flow (defines the shape of the loop). Getting a harness ready for production means asking six questions of every primitive, covering persistence, safety and security, observability, resilience, performance, and evaluation.

We are vendor-neutral and do not resell models or platforms. Our training is based on the open Harness Engineering curriculum: https://github.com/averagejoeslab/harness-engineering

Based in Houston, Texas; engagements are delivered remotely or on-site.

## Services

### Advisory
- Agent Strategy & Use-Case Design: define the work, select models suited to it, design the harness around them
- Harness Assessment: review existing agents against the five primitives and six production questions
- Agent Governance & Operating Model: autonomy, approval, and ownership policies

### Build
- Purpose-Built Agent Harnesses: single and multi-agent harnesses with human-in-the-loop control flow
- Agent Platform Engineering: shared harness foundation, model gateway, sandboxed execution, developer experience
- Context Engineering: instructions, persistent memory, retrieval, context window management
- Tools & Integrations: tool design, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, API and data connectors
- Production Hardening: persistence, security, observability, resilience, performance
- Agent Evaluation: task suites with known right answers, outcome-based checks, regression gates

### Enable
- Co-Build Engagements: build a harness alongside client engineers on a real use case
- Harness Engineering Advisory: architecture reviews, design office hours, code reviews
- Agent Platform Team Setup: charter, reference architectures, internal standards

### Training
- Harness Engineering Bootcamp: 2–3 days, build a harness from scratch one primitive at a time
- Production Harness Engineering: 2-day workshop on the six production questions
- Agent Platform Engineering: 1–2 day workshop
- Evaluating Agents: 1-day workshop
- What Agents Are Made Of: half-day executive briefing
- Custom Programs: tailored, on-site or live virtual
